falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The mini-top analogue resolved into a completed breakdown, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong: the phase was a topping reversal and the correct signal was risk-off, not flat.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the S&P 500 closes at a new 63-day high on the same day the NYSE cumulative advance-decline line closes at a 63-day high and spot VIX closes below 14.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% match to mini_top_2019_jun is invalidated by confirmed upside continuation, so UNKNOWN/HOLD was wrong: the regime was risk-on, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days spot VIX closes above VIX3M on at least two sessions and ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 50 basis points or more from its level on the verdict date.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Cross-asset stress has named the regime, so UNKNOWN is falsified and HOLD was wrong because de-risking, not a flat stance, was required.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
